messages:
jennifer.s: customer reported sudden 401s after we rotated API keys for tenant `acme-prod`. says their ingestion workers started failing at 04:12 UTC.

alex.k: opened ticket 98321, attaching initial error snippets from their side. can you grab logs from the proxy?

vault-bot: rotation event recorded: key_id=kk_2026_04_11_decom, tenant=acme-prod, rotated_by=jennifer.s

samuel.t: quick check — are they on dedicated or hosted?

jennifer.s: hosted. they said we decommissioned an old key and pushed a new one. policy scope looks identical. errors show `permission_denied: invalid_api_key` not `scope_denied`.

alex.k: hmm. that usually means the key presented doesn't match any active key in our auth store (Vault/KMS layer) OR the edge cache still has the old key mapping and we revoked before cache TTL expired. can we repro a request from their pod?

kevin.ops: customer sent curl. logs from our edge show `auth: key not found`, then downstream returned 401. pulling sidecar logs from their k8s deployment now.

jennifer.s: sidecar logs snippet from their pod (they pasted into ticket):
```
2026-04-11T04:11:54Z sidecar INFO fetch-secrets: reading /var/run/secrets/redwood/apikey
2026-04-11T04:11:54Z sidecar DEBUG kv-lookup: using secret ref vault://secret/data/apikeys/acme-prod/worker
2026-04-11T04:11:54Z sidecar WARN key-match: signature mismatch for key_id kk_2025_11_03
2026-04-11T04:11:54Z sidecar INFO env-export: set REDWOOD_API_KEY to value from secret name "acme-legacy"
2026-04-11T04:11:55Z app ERROR auth: request to /v1/generate failed with 401 (invalid api key)
```

samuel.t: that log is suspicious — sidecar read `acme-legacy` secret when the new key is `acme-prod-v2`. why would it pick `acme-legacy`?

alex.k: possible causes: deployment automation wrote wrong secret name during key roll (CI job), or the service-account-to-tenant binding in our secret-sync job is stale. remember the secret-sync maps SA -> tenant namespace via annotation `redwood/tenant`. if that annotation is wrong it will sync legacy secret.

kevin.ops: i pulled the cluster: the pod's serviceAccount is `ingest-wrk-acme`. the secret-sync configmap shows mapping `ingest-wrk-acme -> acme-legacy` (old). our rotation job should have bumped that to `acme-prod-v2`. looks like the roll-forward step failed for that SA.

jennifer.s: any idea why? the rotation pipeline succeeded and updated Vault, but maybe the deploy step that patches k8s never ran.

alex.k: checking CI job logs: the pipeline had a transient API error when calling the cluster patch endpoint and retried only the Vault update, not the k8s patch. so Vault has new key, k8s sidecar kept old secret name. that explains invalid key.

samuel.t: repro steps to confirm — from our side run:
```
# show which secret sidecar sees
kubectl exec -n acme deploy/ingest-workers -- env | grep REDWOOD_API_KEY
# inspect secret-sync mapping
kubectl get configmap redwood-secret-sync -n infra -o yaml
# check vault value
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/apikeys/acme-prod/worker | jq .data.data
```

kevin.ops: ran the first two against their cluster (with customer's consent). output:
```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=kk_2025_11_03
# configmap mapping contains: "ingest-wrk-acme": "acme-legacy"
```

alex.k: root cause summary: key rotation completed in Vault but the k8s patch that updates secret-sync mapping to the new secret name failed (transient CI -> kube API error). sidecar continued to read and export the legacy secret name, so the worker used decommissioned key and began seeing 401s when the old key was revoked.

jennifer.s: proposed mitigation steps for customer (quick):
- roll back revocation (rehabilitate legacy key) OR re-create secret with legacy key value in the expected secret name so sidecar continues to work temporarily
- patch secret-sync configmap to point SA to new secret name, then force sidecar refresh (restart pods)
- CI: add retry+verify for k8s patch step (idempotent check)

samuel.t: add final step: purge edge cache for that tenant key mapping (if we revoked key earlier, edge may cache negative lookups). run: `redwood-infra flush-cache --tenant acme-prod --key kk_2025_11_03`

kevin.ops: executed manual fix with customer: patched configmap mapping -> `acme-prod-v2`, restarted deployment, verified pod env now shows new key id `kk_2026_04_11_decom`. curl against API succeeds with 200. customer confirmed ingestion resumed.

jennifer.s: customer asked for postmortem and prevention. i'll file followup with CI team to ensure k8s patch is retried/verified and make rotation pipeline idempotent (verify sidecar sees new secret) before revoking old key.

alex.k: note for runbook: on future rotations, sequence should be: 1) create new key in Vault 2) write k8s secret + update secret-sync mapping 3) verify pods pick up new key (env check) 4) only then revoke old key 5) flush edge negative cache. include rollback commands in case of failure.

jennifer.s: thanks all. i told customer i would follow up with timeline. :thumbsup:

kevin.ops: closing on our side; added tags `rotation` `secret-sync` `high-impact` to the support ticket.

alex.k: small action: i'll add a check in the rotation job that reads back the k8s mapping and the sidecar env before finishing. low-effort but prevents this class of outages.

samuel.t: 👍

jennifer.s: closing thread, will attach full logs to ticket 98321 and draft postmortem.
